Subject: PO routing & entitlements for Azure Private Plan

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move forward with the Azure Private Plan for our inference workloads. Procurement has two quick asks before we can issue the PO:

1) Confirm the invoice recipient and billing address to put on the PO (we need the legal name and remit-to).

Attaching our PO template so you can see the required fields.

Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO routing & entitlements for Azure Private Plan

Thanks — quick clarifications from the marketplace/legal side.

- The draft Stephanie attached reflects a 60/40 split for co-sell eligible revenue (Microsoft/Partner). That’s the standard we’ve been operating under with the Private Plan.
- BluePeak will not need a separately Microsoft-signed exhibit to issue a PO; however, Microsoft typically requires the exhibit to be provisioned in the Private Offer artifacts in the marketplace listing for co-sell processing. We can trigger the listing upload; Marissa, can you confirm if we should upload the exhibit as-is or include the signed Microsoft terms?
- SKU GUID: RED-PL-ENT-2026-09 GUID: 9f4e2a5b-... (please use this identifier for mapping).

Ben — billing path: can you confirm whether BluePeak should route PO to procurement@bluepeak.com or to an Ariba/Invoice portal? We need to ensure the invoice references the HubSpot deal ID so entitlement reconciliation is automatic.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
